name: FEBRL4 linkage precision, names + DOB
baseline_source: preclink 1.2.0 README benchmark table (recordlinkage recipe in examples/benchmark_febrl.py): https://pypi.org/project/preclink/1.2.0/
note: FEBRL4 (5,000 + 5,000 synthetic Australian records, known 1:1 mapping; not made by the team). Wasl config names_dob: name = given + surname, DOB; no sex, no ID (FEBRL's 7-digit soc_sec_id cannot fill the Emirates-ID slot); encoder, features, LightGBM scorer, 0.7 union threshold and merge rules unchanged; final clusters scored. Wasl 0.979 [0.974, 0.983] (4332/4425), Wilson 95%. Baseline uses address, suburb and postcode (fields Wasl does not have) and blocks on postcode; reproduced exactly by recordlinkage 0.16 rerun by scripts/bench_febrl_recordlinkage.py.

name: FEBRL4 false-match rate, names + DOB
note: Share of the 5,000 B records auto-linked to at least one wrong A record. Wasl 0.013 [0.011, 0.017] (67/5000); missed-match rate 0.134 [0.124, 0.143] (668/5000). With the human-review band (score 0.2 to 0.7) added, recall 0.902 at precision 0.977 (direct pairs).

name: FEBRL4 linkage recall, names + DOB + ID (adapted)
baseline_source: preclink 1.2.0 README benchmark table (recordlinkage recipe in examples/benchmark_febrl.py): https://pypi.org/project/preclink/1.2.0/
note: Adaptation: soc_sec_id wrapped into a synthetic 784-prefixed Luhn-valid number so Wasl's Emirates-ID rules apply (equal -> forced link; both valid and different -> never linked). Precision 1.000 [0.999, 1.000] (4561/4561), recall 0.912 [0.904, 0.920] (4561/5000). Every miss is a record whose ID FEBRL corrupted: a valid-looking but wrong ID vetoes the link, which is Wasl's designed behaviour.

name: Arabic-Latin name encoder ROC-AUC, hard negatives
note: Sayedyousef/arabic-name-pairs (CC-BY-4.0; single-token names, merged from JRC-Names, machine translation and an LLM by its author). Name encoder alone, no scorer. 22,489 pairs after removing 183 exact overlaps with the encoder's training pairs. Hard negative: another Arabic name with the same first letter and length within one letter. 95% interval [0.9940, 0.9954] (Hanley-McNeil).

name: Arabic-Latin name encoder top-1 retrieval, Latin to Arabic
note: Sayedyousef/arabic-name-pairs (CC-BY-4.0; single-token names, merged from JRC-Names, machine translation and an LLM by its author). Name encoder alone, no scorer. 22,489 pairs after removing 183 exact overlaps with the encoder's training pairs. Gallery 12,493 Arabic names. Top-1 0.869 [0.864, 0.873] (19534/22486); top-10 (the linker's candidate depth) 0.985 [0.983, 0.986] (22142/22486); Arabic to Latin top-1 0.885 [0.879, 0.890] (11056/12493).

name: Arabic-Latin name encoder precision at a cosine threshold
note: Sayedyousef/arabic-name-pairs (CC-BY-4.0; single-token names, merged from JRC-Names, machine translation and an LLM by its author). Name encoder alone, no scorer. 22,489 pairs after removing 183 exact overlaps with the encoder's training pairs. The runtime has no standalone encoder threshold (cosine feeds top-10 blocking and the scorer), so cosine 0.735 was picked for best F1 on a random 20% of pairs and reported on the other 80% with one hard negative per positive: precision 0.981 [0.978, 0.982] (17719/18070), recall 0.986 [0.984, 0.988] (17719/17970).

name: Arabic-Latin name encoder top-1 retrieval, names never seen in training
note: Strict subset: 1,440 pairs whose English string and every Arabic token never occur as a word in any training name. Smaller gallery (519 Arabic names), so not comparable with the full-set number. Top-1 0.948 [0.935, 0.958] (1365/1440); ROC-AUC hard negatives 0.9978.
